summary.intent: Execute Phase 34 (E2E Test Expansion & Staging Baselines) — create account cleanup helpers, media/streaming E2E suites, batch download tests, and capture meaningful load test baselines against staging with BYO-IPFS (Pinata) support.
summary.outcome: All 4 plans executed and verified (13/13 must-haves). Real 200-client sustained load baselines captured (0.17% error rate, ~11k ops). BYO capacity ceiling baseline captured across all 5 tiers, though Pinata pin operations failed with 100% error rate. Phase marked complete with caveats on BYO pinning.

repo: Staging Web3Auth (Core Kit) initialization takes ~22.7s — wallet button timeout in E2E specs must be ≥30s for staging runs (was 20s, caused timeouts).
playwright.config.ts did not respect BASE_URL env var for targeting staging — required explicit fix to read process.env.BASE_URL and disable webServer block when set.
The deleteAccountViaPage cleanup helper hardcoded localhost:3000 as API URL — on staging the API is at api-staging.cipherbox.cc; helper needed to derive API URL from page URL hostname.
Vitest does not auto-load .env files — dotenv must be sourced in the shell before invoking vitest (e.g. `source .env && pnpm vitest run`).
Running two SDK load test suites simultaneously against staging saturates the instance regardless of throttle bypass header — root cause of initial 429 failures was concurrency, not bypass mechanism.
THROTTLE_BYPASS_SECRET works correctly end-to-end (curl, Node fetch, vitest) — no code bug, the bypass guard logic is sound.
BYO Pinata pin operations fail with 100% error rate in the capacity ceiling test — likely auth or endpoint configuration issue in PinataProvider, not a staging API issue.

load test threshold values in vitest config are tuned for small client counts — 200-client runs will exceed p95 thresholds and exit code 1 even on successful runs; results must be read from output, not inferred from exit code.

code.finding: waitFor timeout of 20_000ms insufficient for staging Web3Auth init; increased to 45_000ms
deleteAccountViaPage derived API URL from hardcoded localhost:3000; fixed to derive from page URL hostname to support staging
Added BASE_URL env var support and conditional webServer block — skip local dev server when BASE_URL points to external host
No dotenv loading configured — env vars must be sourced in shell before invoking vitest; attempted loadEnv (Vite-only, not available in vitest config context)

workflow: Cherry-picking worktree commits to a phase branch causes STATE.md conflicts — always stash local changes first, cherry-pick, resolve conflict keeping worktree version, then restore stash.
Parallel subagent execution on the same git repo causes index.lock contention — prune and force-remove stale worktrees before retrying failed agents.
GSD worktree agents commit to their own worktree branch; orchestrator must cherry-pick to the phase branch manually — commits are not auto-merged.
Load test diagnostics: always test with a single isolated run before concluding bypass/auth mechanisms are broken — simultaneous test runs are the most common false positive.
The classifyHandoffIfNeeded Claude Code runtime bug can cause agents to report 'failed' even when all work completed — always spot-check SUMMARY.md and git commits before treating as real failure.

friction: 34-04 committed to worktree branch only — required manual cherry-pick with STATE.md conflict resolution to get commits onto phase branch.
34-03 failed on first attempt due to git index.lock contention from parallel execution; required worktree cleanup and retry.
Two load tests ran simultaneously on first attempt, causing mutual throttling that was initially misdiagnosed as a bypass header bug — required multiple diagnostic iterations.
loadEnv is a Vite-specific export not available in vitest config; led to failed attempt at automatic .env loading before settling on shell-level source.
SSH access to staging Docker containers failed (timeout/key issue) — could not inspect live container env vars directly.
Premature phase completion was committed to ROADMAP.md/STATE.md before baselines were confirmed meaningful — required targeted revert.
34.1 gap-closure phase was incorrectly inserted before confirming the throttle bypass issue was a code problem (it wasn't) — had to revert the insertion.
BYO capacity ceiling test ran concurrently with sustained load test on first attempt, invalidating both results.
open_items: BYO Pinata pin operations fail with 100% error rate in capacity ceiling test — root cause unknown (possibly PinataProvider auth header format, endpoint URL, or JWT scope); needs investigation.

New media E2E specs (streaming-playback, media-preview) use binary stub fixtures — need live environment run to confirm they trigger expected AES-CTR/GCM code paths (1 human verification item outstanding).
SDK test harness createTestAccount does not batch with rate-aware backoff — at 200 clients, account creation takes ~38s; could be parallelized more aggressively with jitter.
Load test threshold values need tuning for 200-client scale — current values cause exit code 1 even on healthy runs, making CI integration misleading.
Staging Web3Auth 22.7s init time should be investigated — may indicate SDK cold-start optimization opportunity or misconfigured caching.

Journey timing spec tests 2 and 3 did not run (skipped after test 1 failure) — only Journey 1 baseline was captured on first attempt; subsequent runs got all 3 but the skip behavior on failure should be reviewed.
Learnings file created at .learnings/2026-03-29-staging-load-test-throttle-bypass.md documenting the simultaneous-run root cause — should be referenced before future load test runs.
